$comment: Written 2026-10-06 before the run it gates, never edited to pass. Supersedes m5-max.2026-09-21.json, which stays as the record: its 5 ms script gate was met at 2.5 ms when written, but the bundled headless Chromium has moved since, and on 2026-10-06 main itself (effedf0) reads script p99 7.50 ms with two dropped frames on this machine — the old gate had come to measure the browser build, not the grid. Both numbers here are re-derived from that same-day main reading: script headroom that still catches a half-again regression, and the two dropped frames main shows at rest, which land at random frame numbers with low script time — the build misses the odd vsync on its own.
machine: Apple M5 Max, 128 GB, macOS 27.0, Playwright Chromium headless
